basic.description: Melee attacks and retaliations deal +10% physical damage. At subsequent level-ups, Offense has a 10% chance to grant +1 Attack.

advanced.description: Melee attacks and retaliations deal +20% physical damage. Attack-growth chance becomes 20%.

expert.description: Melee attacks and retaliations deal +30% physical damage. Attack-growth chance becomes 30%.

basic.description: Physical creature attacks and retaliations against the hero's army deal 5% less damage. At subsequent level-ups, Armorer has a 10% chance to grant +1 Defense.

advanced.description: Physical creature-attack reduction increases to 10%. Defense-growth chance becomes 20%.

expert.description: Physical creature-attack reduction increases to 15%. Defense-growth chance becomes 30%.

basic.description: Ranged creature attacks deal +10% physical damage. At subsequent level-ups, Archery has a 10% chance to grant +1 Attack.

advanced.description: Ranged creature attacks deal +20% physical damage. Attack-growth chance becomes 20%.

expert.description: Ranged creature attacks deal +30% physical damage. Attack-growth chance becomes 30%.

basic.description: After a friendly stack Waits, its next attack or retaliation before the end of the round deals +5% physical damage. A stack that Defends gains an additional 5% physical creature-damage reduction until its next activation.

advanced.description: The conditional Wait damage bonus and Defend reduction become 10%.

expert.description: The conditional Wait damage bonus and Defend reduction become 15%.

basic.description: +20 Siege. Grants direct control over the hero's war machines.

advanced.description: +40 Siege total.

expert.description: +60 Siege total.

basic.description: Friendly army receives +1 Morale.

advanced.description: Friendly army receives +2 Morale total.

expert.description: Friendly army receives +3 Morale total.

basic.description: Muster once per week in a friendly town: add 2 Core creatures to one Core dwelling's recruitment pool.

advanced.description: Muster once per week: add either 4 Core creatures to one Core dwelling or 1 Elite creature to one Elite dwelling.

expert.description: Muster once per week: add either 6 Core creatures, 2 Elite creatures, or 1 Champion creature to one corresponding dwelling pool.

basic.description: Attribute-derived components of Orders operate at 110% Command Efficiency.

advanced.description: Attribute-derived components operate at 120% Command Efficiency.

expert.description: Attribute-derived components operate at 130% Command Efficiency.

basic.description: Basic Light Magic grants Basic mastery of Light spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Light Magic grants Advanced mastery of Light spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Light Magic grants Expert mastery of Light spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Basic Shadow Magic grants Basic mastery of Shadow spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Shadow Magic grants Advanced mastery of Shadow spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Shadow Magic grants Expert mastery of Shadow spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Basic Nature Magic grants Basic mastery of Nature spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Nature Magic grants Advanced mastery of Nature spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Nature Magic grants Expert mastery of Nature spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Basic Havoc Magic grants Basic mastery of Havoc spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Havoc Magic grants Advanced mastery of Havoc spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Havoc Magic grants Expert mastery of Havoc spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Basic Sorcery Magic grants Basic mastery of Sorcery spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Sorcery Magic grants Advanced mastery of Sorcery spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Sorcery Magic grants Expert mastery of Sorcery spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Basic Chaos Magic grants Basic mastery of Chaos spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

advanced.description: Advanced Chaos Magic grants Advanced mastery of Chaos spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

expert.description: Expert Chaos Magic grants Expert mastery of Chaos spells. Spell effects and mana costs use this mastery when the spell provides a corresponding benefit. Wisdom still governs access to higher-level spells.

basic.description: Spell Power-derived numerical components of spells operate at 110% Spellcraft Efficiency. At subsequent level-ups, Spellcraft has a 10% chance to grant +1 Spell Power.

advanced.description: Spell Power-derived components operate at 120%. Spell Power-growth chance becomes 20%.

expert.description: Spell Power-derived components operate at 130%. Spell Power-growth chance becomes 30%.

basic.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 10%. At subsequent level-ups, Wisdom has a 10% chance to grant +1 Knowledge.

advanced.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 20%. Knowledge-growth chance becomes 20%.

expert.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 30%. Knowledge-growth chance becomes 30%.

basic.description: After using the Hero Action to cast a Spell, the next Order issued before the end of the next round gains +10 percentage points of efficiency on its attribute-derived components. After using the Hero Action to issue an Order, the next Spell cast before the end of the next round gains +10% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

advanced.description: Both alternating bonuses become 20% / +20 percentage points.

expert.description: Both alternating bonuses become 30% / +30 percentage points.

basic.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 10%.

advanced.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 20%.

expert.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 30%.

basic.description: An eligible neutral stack with Army Value no greater than 25% of the hero's current army may offer to join for its normal recruitment gold cost.

advanced.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 50% of the hero's Army Value.

expert.description: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 75% of the hero's Army Value.

basic.description: The kingdom receives +125 Gold per day while the hero is active.

advanced.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +250 Gold.

expert.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +500 Gold.

basic.description: Experience gained by the hero increases by 10%.

advanced.description: Experience gained increases by 20%.

expert.description: Experience gained increases by 30%.

basic.description: Friendly army receives +1 Luck.

advanced.description: Friendly army receives +2 Luck total.

expert.description: Friendly army receives +3 Luck total.

basic.description: Once per combat, when the hero uses the Hero Action to cast a Light Spell, immediately issue one Order; or after using the Hero Action to issue an Order, immediately cast one Light Spell.

advanced.description: Divine Mandate may be used twice per combat.

expert.description: Divine Mandate may be used three times per combat.

basic.description: +1 Luck. Lucky Strike damage multiplier becomes 2.25x.

advanced.description: +2 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 2.60x.

expert.description: +3 Luck total. Lucky Strike multiplier becomes 3.00x.

basic.description: Once per combat, after using the Hero Action to cast a Spell, immediately cast one additional Spell.

advanced.description: Metamagic may be used twice per combat.

expert.description: Metamagic may be used three times per combat.

basic.description: Friendly stacks gain Ghost Walk: they may move through occupied creature hexes but may not end movement on an occupied hex. Flanking melee attacks deal +25% damage.

advanced.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +40%.

expert.description: Ghost Walk remains active. Flanking melee bonus becomes +60%, and flanking melee attacks deny normal retaliation.

basic.description: A friendly Inferno stack may spend its Creature Activation to open a Gate on a legal empty hex within 3 hexes. At the start of the next round, one Core stack from the Demonic Reserve arrives there.

advanced.description: Gating may bring Core or Elite reserve stacks.

expert.description: Gating may bring Core, Elite, or Champion reserve stacks.

basic.description: After victory, raise Skeletons equal to 10% of eligible living enemy creature casualties, rounded down.

advanced.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 20% of eligible casualties.

expert.description: Raise Skeletons equal to 30% of eligible casualties.

basic.description: Each non-summoned stack destroyed grants surviving friendly stacks +5% damage, cumulative to +20%.

advanced.description: Each destruction grants +8% damage, cumulative to +40%.

expert.description: Each destruction grants +12% damage, cumulative to +60%.

basic.description: While a friendly stack Defends, it gains additional physical damage reduction equal to 5% + 0.10% × Hero Defense until its next activation. The first melee attacker is struck pre-emptively for 50% normal damage.

advanced.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 7.5% + 0.15% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 75%; the stack reflects 25% of actual melee physical damage received after reductions.

expert.description: Bulwark reduction becomes 10% + 0.20% × Hero Defense; pre-emptive damage becomes 100%; melee reflection becomes 50%.

basic.description: When a non-summoned allied stack is destroyed, summon a random Elite Elemental stack at that position with aggregate HP equal to 25% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

advanced.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 40% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.

expert.description: Reborn Elemental HP becomes 50% of the destroyed stack's maximum aggregate HP.
